primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'P_p': 'Projection value for player p (fantasy points)', 'U_p': 'Player availability status (boolean)', 'T_f': "Friday's final news timestamp (UTC)"}

primitives.breakdown_regime: P_p computed before T_f and U_p = false.

layer2.mapping: Detection function f(P_p, U_p, T_f) = 1 if stale else 0; uses retroactive validation.
